title: Unassigned opens expanded, keeps its header in view and loads as you scroll
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Use a location whose All tab holds several hundred work orders with no lead technician (long-running test locations usually do: check in List with the All tab). The board loads every row at once when about 300 or fewer match, so paging only shows above that.
  6. Make sure Unassigned has not been collapsed by this user (if it was, expand it once).
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  4. Look at the Unassigned group.
  5. Scroll down through the Unassigned rows for a while.
  6. Look at the top of the screen while scrolling.
  7. Keep scrolling to the end of Unassigned, watching what happens when you reach the last loaded rows.
  8. Collapse Unassigned using the arrow on its header while you are deep inside the group.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Unassigned opens expanded.
  • Its header stays on screen while you scroll through its rows, so you can collapse it from anywhere: the collapse works without scrolling back up.
  • Rows arrive in batches as you scroll (a short loading pause or more rows appearing at the end), not all at once on opening. The Unassigned count in the header matches the number of unassigned work orders List shows for the All tab.
  • That rows are fetched in pages behind the scenes cannot be proven by hand: if no loading pause is visible, write "paging not seen by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on the rest.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View — table grouped by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S2-R18, read 8 Oct 2026. Tech plan revised 24 Sep 2026 (uploaded 8 Oct 2026), section 3.1. PRD footer comment Slavcho Mitrov 2 Oct 2026 item 6, folded into the 7 Oct PRD.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R18: “Unassigned opens expanded unless the user collapsed it (S2-R13), and its header stays on screen while scrolling so it can be collapsed from anywhere. When it holds more work orders than fit on screen, which on the All tab can be thousands, it loads them in pages as the user scrolls, as List does, never all at once.”
  • Tech plan 3.1: “One request returns every group with counts; it also returns all cards when the filtered total ≤ ~300 (configurable; true for the Work Orders view at every location). Above that, cards come for the pinned + on-screen groups, then batches of ≤ 6 groups horizontally and 25 cards per group vertically.”
